items.title: Volta Infra raises $300M at $2.4B valuation for AI cloud infrastructure
items.note: Nvidia and Michael Dell join the a16z/Altimeter round, bundled with a $10B, six-year compute deal with Anthropic

items.title: Meta ships Muse Code and Muse Spark 1.2 for agentic coding
items.note: New terminal coding agent jumps to 82.9% on Terminal-Bench 2.1, up from 76.2% for the prior version

items.title: Naïve raises $28.5M to automate company setup and back-office work with AI agents
items.note: Nexus Venture Partners leads Series A for agent templates spanning SEO, SaaS, recruiting, accounting and support

items.title: Louisiana's new wholesaling law takes effect, mandatory cancellation notice now required
items.note: Act 807 gives sellers a right to cancel and requires a minimum 1% escrowed deposit, effective August 1

items.title: Weak July jobs report gives homebuyers a silver lining
items.note: Economy lost 23,000 jobs, raising odds the Fed holds rates steady and eases affordability pressure

items.title: CrowdStrike's Falcon Fund makes strategic investment in Israeli startup Above Security
items.note: Tel Aviv insider-threat platform gets deeper Falcon integration just 5 months after its $43M Series A

items.title: Index Ventures raises $3.5B, earmarks fresh capital for Israeli startups
items.note: New seed, venture and growth funds follow the firm's roughly $3.8B payout from Google's Wiz acquisition
